rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Ack... After coming up with
this new Special, and me being
a pro adventurer and all...

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0002
rows.name: Oh, you came at just the right time.

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Would you like to perform the
'Beautiful Rose Ensemble' with me?

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Don't get it? In terms ordinary people
like you can understand, it's
consecutive attacks using Specials.

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Chain Specials together and
element orbs will appear, letting
you fight with the upper hand.

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0006
rows.name:
But even I get tired of using
Specials one after another, so I
needed someone to keep up with me.

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0007
rows.name:
Hmm... You seem quite skilled, but you
appear to be lacking a little
elegance.

rows.label: tlk70000122_03_msg0008
rows.name:
Sorry, but maybe doing the
Rose-in-Bloom with you can
wait till another time.
